decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
<p>The proposed green roof hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details submitted and the ORHH Green Roof Specification dated 08/06/2025.</p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Arboricultural Impact Assessment, CE4796, CE4796-01, Form 4 – Reasonable Exception Statement, GHA/DS/160245:25, ORHH EX01, ORHHGreen Roof Specification, ORHH HS, ORHH PE01B, ORHH SP02E, ORHH SS01, Terraflora Landscape Design Drawings and Details, Tree Constraints Plan.

The window(s)/door(s) in the side elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

No site works or development shall commence until details of the levels of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not commence until full details of a built in bat box for the site have been submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include the type and location of the bat box to be built into the structure.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the details hereby approved and prior to the commencement of the relevant part of works hereby approved, full details of the proposed rear pergola structure and garden shed shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include plans and elevation drawings, details of materials and finishes. The development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the details hereby approved and prior to the completion of the extensions hereby approved, a scheme of hard and soft landscape works shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p><p><br></p><p>Soft Landscaping works to include:</p><p>(a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Details of retained trees and landscaping features</p><p>(b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Protection measures of the retained trees and landscaping features in the course of development.</p><p>(c)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100)</p><p>(d)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers / densities&nbsp;</p><p>(e)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken&nbsp;</p><p>(f)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>A landscape implementation programme with proposed timing / dates for the work, including a 5 year period for replacements of soft landscape</p><p><br></p><p>Hard Landscaping works to include:</p><p>(g)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Full details of hardstanding</p><p>(h)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Full details of permeable paving</p><p>(i)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Full details of boundary treatment</p>
description: Single and two storey rear extension, Green roof to ground floor rear extension, Alterations to roof to form rear dormers, External alterations (Demolition of car port at side)
